full.description: This image is a micrograph showing a histological section of tissue with a branching papillary architecture lined by epithelium and supported by a fibrovascular core. The tissue displays cleft-like spaces and prominent folds reminiscent of certain benign or low-grade proliferative lesions. The epithelial lining is regular, and the underlying stroma contains fibrous and muscular elements. Overall, the histological features are characteristic of a benign papillary or polypoid lesion, such as a gallbladder adenomyomatosis or a similar papillary neoplasm.

blind.description: This is a microscopic image of a tumour tissue sample. The histology reveals epithelial-like cells lining cleft-like spaces and gland-like structures, accompanied by spindle cell areas exhibiting a fibrosarcoma-like growth pattern. These features are characteristic of a biphasic malignant neoplasm, such as synovial sarcoma or a similar spindle cell malignancy with epithelial differentiation.
